context: A marker must end a title/version label or precede a trailing quality/source tag. A marker embedded in ordinary title prose is not sufficient.

rules.label: ソロ・リミックス / ソロ Ver. / ソロ・バージョン
rules.pattern: ソロ[\s・._-]*(?:リミックス|バージョン|version|ver\.?)(?![a-z])

rules.label: Game / TV / Short 版本（独立选项）

named_group_version.label: 已知组合名 Ver.（独立选项）
named_group_version.match: A parenthesized or bracketed version label whose entire subject equals one known group or its unambiguous original artist alias after NFKC and whitespace removal.

named_character_version.label: 单个已知角色名 Ver.（独立选项）
named_character_version.match: A parenthesized or bracketed version label whose entire subject equals one known character after NFKC and whitespace removal.
